request.text: A downloaded payload on DESKTOP-CQF82L6 has opened a shell and is tampering with the Security event log. Stop process 7224 (payload.exe) on DESKTOP-CQF82L6.

package.rationale: payload.exe (PID 7224), run by pedro from the Downloads folder with high integrity, connects to 10.0.10.104:8443 and opened a cmd.exe shell, from which wevtutil set-log moved the Security log to C:\Windows\System32\winevt\Not-Important-Log.evtx. This impairs Security event logging under the payload's control; stop PID 7224 now.
